goal: Prevent network observers from correlating I2P session setup with outbound connection timing
Improve privacy for users making outbound I2P connections without listening mode
reviewability: Needs rebase and the author has been silent for 186 days
agreement: Concept support for decoupling session creation from use to protect anonymity (zzzi2p)
Concerns about resource waste from idle sessions were resolved by reducing pool size to one
Open suggestion to address external review comments (willcl-ark, jonatack)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it mitigates timing correlation attacks against non-listening I2P nodes
It provides a clear privacy improvement for outbound I2P users that is reasonably deferrable
